sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner in CRMP No. 2667 of 2025 submits that a settlement has been arrived at between petitioner, namely Kapil Chandrakant Shelke, and complainant/respondent No. 2, Rounak Goyal, who is stated to have received the agreed amount pursuant to the said settlement.
It is further submitted that the remaining petitioners are Directors of different Companies and are not parties to the said settlement.

The settlement agreement dated 15.10.2025, entered into between petitioner, Kapil Chandrakant Shelke, and respondent No. 2,
Rounak Goyal, has been annexed along with the petitions.
It is further submitted that the original settlement agreement is in the possession of petitioner, Kapil Chandrakant Shelke.
4. Learned counsel for respondent No. 2 is present; however, he does not acknowledge or confirm the said settlement at this stage.

5. In view of the above, the Investigation Officer, Police Station Pandri, District Raipur (C.G.), is directed to verify the authenticity and validity of the alleged compromise arrived at between petitioner, Kapil Chandrakant Shelke, and the complainant/respondent No. 2, Rounak Goyal, and thereafter submit a report in accordance with law before the competent Court after due verification of the settlement dated 15.10.2025.

The said report shall also take into consideration the role of the remaining petitioners, who are also arrayed as accused in the present case, and shall be submitted within a period of four weeks from today.
The interim protection granted earlier shall continue for a further period of four weeks from today.
6. The Superintendent of Police, Raipur, shall ensure due compliance with the directions issued by this Court.
7. With the aforesaid directions, the present petition stands disposed of.

8. Learned State counsel is directed to send a copy of this order to the Superintendent of Police,
Raipur, for necessary information.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
